svg.title: Double-strap in-phase and opposite-phase Maxwell E and H fields
svg.desc: Four actual field maps from the two three-dimensional phase excitations, sharing colour scales within each field type and normalized to delivered power.

g.text: Double strap: 3D Maxwell fields at y = 0 (p=2, h_max=0.04 m)
Each complex field is divided by sqrt(its solved delivered power). Shared scales within columns; source runs use 1 A peak per gap. PEC is masked.
